set: A: acting, one sheet across each of the five beats, with no time and no word on it

issues.where: crank and meter, first two rows
issues.what: The arrow disappears against the moving handle, then appears across the meter while the crank spins on the other side. The number climbs but the character's effort and responsibility for turning the crank aren't consistently visible.
issues.fix: Keep the tip visibly anchored to the knob through at least one full turn, and pose a lean against the load before the release. Hold a distinct compressed recoil at 100% before the unsteady exit.

issues.where: rotary dial, first two rows and start of third
issues.what: The small white arrow overlaps highlights and white dial holes, obscuring its silhouette and making the effort look like ordinary pointing. Its later recoil is much clearer than the work that triggers it.
issues.fix: Stage the cursor body outside the rim with just its tip on a hole. Show a braced pull pose, stretch on release, and hold the recoil in the clear space beside the dial.

issues.where: approach to the Contact number field, rows two through four
issues.what: The dart has a readable stretch, but afterward the arrow settles into nearly stock cursor poses. The form opening supplies the payoff without a separate held arrow reaction.
issues.fix: Show a short lean away from the field before committing the tip, then a visible squash or recoil and a curious held tilt when the dial rises.

issues.where: right of the lever and above the coins, rows two and three
issues.what: The lever pull is legible, but the arrow returns to a generic pose. Two nearly identical upright poses by the result hold position rather than an emotion, and the coin burst pushes it straight into departure without much readable response.
issues.fix: Pose the arrow in a clear anticipatory lean while the reels stop, then compress it on the coin burst and hold a tilted, withdrawn silhouette before it leaves.

issues.where: left edge of Continue through the retreat, rows one through three
issues.what: The contact pose is held, but the tip and shadow merge into the edge of the button, and several repeats read as hover rather than hesitation. The blurred departure is clearer than the decision or the exit reaction.
issues.fix: Keep a sliver of separation on a pulled-back wind-up, then give the button press its own compact, identifiable arrow silhouette before stretching away and counter-tilting against the departing form.

issues.what: did not read: the three closed rows are read; that the page looks easy and the arrow relaxes is not: the read has it tentatively curious, darting across the fields and hesitating.
issues.fix: Ease in the body before the first click: the arrow slowing, settling and loosening in front of three plain rows, held long enough to be read as relief.

issues.what: did not read: the dialing and the form giving up are read; that on the return the dial whips the arrow in a full circle and flings it is not: the read has it startled, springing back and steadying itself.
issues.fix: The whip as the event of the beat: the arrow carried the whole way round by the returning dial, seen on the dial through the turn, then thrown clear along the line of the throw and landing where the throw sends it.

issues.what: did not read: the cranking and the meter filling to 100% are read; that the crank takes off by itself, spins to full and flattens the arrow on the way round is not: the read has it trying hard, then rattled or worn out, wobbling away.
issues.fix: The moment the crank leaves the arrow's hold as its own beat: the arrow thrown off and left behind, the handle seen to speed up alone, then the handle striking the arrow and the arrow flat on the page.

issues.what: did not read: the press on Continue is read as a nudge; that the arrow lies flat as paper, peels itself up and refills is not: the read has it hesitant, lingering at Continue.
issues.fix: The flat arrow held on the page long enough to be seen as flat, the peel from one corner, the refill as a swelling back to its body, each a held pose before it goes to Continue.

reads.read: Tentatively curious; the form swings into view, and the arrow darts across the recessed fields, hesitates, then opens Contact number to reveal a rotary dial.
Concentrating on dialing, then startled; the arrow works around the rotary dial until the field accepts the partial number, then springs back, steadies itself and moves toward Date of birth.
Intent on getting a date, then briefly startled by the payoff; the arrow pulls the slot-machine lever, pauses beside the recorded date, jumps away as coins spill out, then approaches Audio volume.
Trying hard, then rattled or worn out; the arrow tackles a volume crank, the meter fills to 100%, and it wobbles away toward the now-lit Continue button.
Hesitant, then committed; the arrow lingers at Continue, nudges it and shoots back toward the middle as the form tilts away beneath it.
